label: GO step when the agent picks a2, early or late in the episode
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.9% of mass; never at D1, a handful of D2 steps), and only when the policy chooses a2 (98% of mass on model_act==2 / action==2; strongest with a very negative choice logit; a1 choices almost never fire). (phase==GO)&(action==2) alone has recall 0.97 but precision 0.27. The extra structure is position in the episode: the rate is high on trials 0-25 and 82-99 and near zero on trials 40-79, a U-shaped dependence on ep_trial that probably reflects a slow drift in the hidden state, not task variables. Stay/switch, transition, reward and the good state change the rate only weakly. I recorded the agent policy argmax (model_act), which is observable and its own choice, in place of the FUTURE action variable; both score the same on dev (F1 0.62, mass recall 0.90). Precision is still around 0.52: many a2 GO steps in the early and late windows stay silent, and what decides them is not a simple function of the reward/transition history. Magnitude goes up with how strongly the policy prefers a2 (choice logit), which I checked only through the choice-bin rates.
